claim: The analytics loaders (analytics.service.ts loadInventory, advanced-analytics.service.ts loadInventoryWithCost, pricing/margin-advice.service.ts adviseHouse and accept) read inventory_lot_agreed_cost and hand has_agreed_cost / agreed_wac to resolveUnitCost, so an item whose only cost is an agreed lot reads as agreed_lot_wac (QA round 20 C; closes the debt filed by RECIPE-READS-AGREED-LOT-COST). Since readers lane r4 (2026-11-12) the three house-wide loaders read the rollup and the agreed view through lot-costs-by-ids.ts readLotCostsByIds (readByIds, whole or refused past 1,000 rows); accept still reads one item's agreed row by id.
